text: 特朗普政府已退还1000亿美元关税，都给谁了？ 美国议员抱怨称，这些资金往往流回了大企业手中，很少能回到那些最终承担了关税成本的消费者或小企业手里。
text_en: Trump administration has refunded $100 billion in tariffs—who got it? U.S. lawmakers complain that these funds often flow back to large corporations, rarely reaching consumers or small businesses that ultimately bear the tariff costs
